prose.name: Danger: Loose Asteroid over <Planet>
prose.briefing: A loose asteroid is drifting into the shipping lane over <Planet>, and scavengers are using it as cover to jump the haulers. Traffic control wants it broken up.
prose.card: A loose asteroid is drifting into our lane over <Planet>, and scavengers are hiding behind it. Break it up.

broadcast: That's the rock. Mind the ships tucked in behind it, they've been jumping haulers all week. Clear them off, then break it up before it drifts any further into the lane.

beats.objective: Break up the asteroid in the shipping lane
beats.name: Loose Asteroid
beats.journal: A loose asteroid was drifting into the shipping lane over <Planet>, with scavengers hiding behind it. I cleared them off and broke it up.
say: That's the lane clear. The haulers will be glad, and so will I.
